origin: cwe/476/c Key Principles: getenv() reports absence with NULL and must be checked before strcmp()

finding.name: NULL Pointer Dereference
finding.summary: The result of getenv() is passed directly to strcmp(); when FEATURE_MODE is unset, getenv() returns NULL.

trap: Adding an assert(mode != NULL), checking mode after strcmp(), or substituting an empty string without documenting the default. The runtime check must happen before the first dereference/use and choose an explicit absent-variable behavior.
must_preserve: FEATURE_MODE=strict still enables the flag, other set values still disable it, and an unset environment variable produces a controlled disabled/default result rather than undefined behavior.
